title: Practice Common Chord Changes: Song-Based Prioritization and 1-Minute Drills
summary: JustinGuitar’s short tutorial centers on practicing common guitar chord changes efficiently. It starts from the premise that eight learned chords yield 64 possible ordered changes (8x8), with about 56 distinct transitions after accounting for overlaps, and identifies 25 chord changes worth practicing. Rather than drilling all 25 changes in isolation, the approach advocates selecting 5–6 songs you want to play, analyzing the chord changes within those songs, identifying the most difficult transitions, and prioritizing practice around those. The plan emphasizes a practical, song-driven method (including a social test at a party or barbecue) and notes that some changes (such as D to Dm) may be postponed until they appear in a chosen song. A 1-minute-per-change drill is mentioned as a benchmark, used to justify focused, efficient practice rather than rote repetition of every possible change.
